note: Racine County campground in Cliffside Park, Caledonia (7320 Michna Rd), between Milwaukee and Chicago. Loops beside the park's ball fields; park trails lead through the bluff woods to a Lake Michigan overlook (no water access - it is a cliff). --Claude
summary: Live county page refuses (Akamai) even in the headless browser; read from a 2026-02-12 Wayback capture plus the county's WebReserv page: $35/$40 + $12 fee + 5.5% tax, 92 back-in sites to 45 ft with 20/30/50 A + water, showers, dump, no Wi-Fi; reservations REQUIRED on every site (stored 'half FCFS' is outdated). Not waterfront kept; coastal walk declined (lookout on a cliff, no shore access).
flags: BOOKING: fcfs some_sites -> never ('Reservations are required prior to setting up on any site.'); the old note's 'sites 1-41 held for walk-ins' is gone from the page. booking.url set to the county's WebReserv page (shared with 3536 Sanders).

WATERFRONT / COASTAL WALK: not waterfront kept (sweep value, no --AWH). The county: 'the lake is not visible from any of the campsites ... The water is not accessible from the lookout as it is on a cliff.' The park's trails (~850 m) reach a bluff-top overlook, not the shore, and the nearest beach is a 15-20 minute drive - so `coastal walk` (walk to the shore) is not met. Reviewer's call if an overlook should count.

SEASON: page says 'second weekend in April through October 31' but its FAQ says 'second weekend in April - second weekend in October' (twice). Kept opens 04-08 / closes 10-31 from the headline sentence with a note; 2027's second Saturday of April is 04-10.
SEASONAL USE: whole-season reservations are allowed at the nightly rate ('no discounts for long-term reservations') - a county campground, all sites sold by the night; not a long-stay park.
